description: EXT-10 D-01's declared tool roster. Names here resolve for `/doctor` even when `pi.getAllTools()` does not currently list them — a package tool whose provider is present but uncredentialed this session, or a tool named in prose before its extension has loaded. Core PI built-ins (bash, read, edit, write, glob, grep, ...) are not listed: they are always present in `pi.getAllTools()` and D-01 checks that live roster first.
